sources.title: modnet: Image-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview modnet is a lightweight deep learning model for portrait matting that removes backgrounds from images in real-time without requiring auxiliary inputs like trimaps. Built by pollinations, this model uses an Efficient Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (e-ASPP) module to fuse multi-scale features and achieves 67 frames per second on a 1080Ti GPU. The model optimizes multiple sub-objectives ...

sources.snippet: modnet huggingface.co is an AI model on huggingface.co that provides modnet's model effect (), which can be used instantly with this Xenova modnet model. huggingface.co supports a free trial of the modnet model, and also provides paid use of the modnet. Support call modnet model through api, including Node.js, Python, http.
